_comment: Adventure-only lines for the town's growth: tier names and celebrations, districts, farm buildings and the town book. Each key holds one line; a missing or empty key falls back to the built-in line in app/lib/game/domain/town/town_growth_lines.dart. Every line is listed in docs/voice-lines.md. Never shame: a town short of food only waits.
tier.reached.hamlet: Smoke from new chimneys: the outpost is a hamlet now. Every day you logged built this.
tier.reached.village: Bells ring over full granaries. The hamlet has grown into a village!
tier.reached.town: Market stalls, cobbled streets, a town hall: your village is a town.
tier.reached.city: Towers on the skyline and lights in every window. Welcome to your city.
district.blurb.outpost: Where the town began: the hall, the yards and the workshops.
district.blurb.farmland: Six fields beyond the wall. Farms and orchards grow food; a granary keeps it.
district.blurb.guardPost: Watchtowers for a village that has something worth guarding.
district.blurb.residential: Cottages and gardens for the people your town draws in.
district.blurb.park: Lawns, a pond and a bandstand for a town at ease.
district.blurb.marketRow: A street of shopfronts for a town that trades.
book.title: Town book
book.top: Prosperity {prosperity}. The town has grown as grand as it can, for now.
book.food: {stored} of {capacity} food in store. The residents eat {need} a day.
book.foodNeeded: To grow into a {tier}, the stores need {food} food: {days} days of meals. The town keeps everything while it waits.
district.locked: Grows into reach at {tier}. Keep logging and building to get there.
district.bought.farmland: Fresh furrows and a red barn: the farmland is yours. Plant a farm to start the harvest.
district.bought: The {district} is yours. Come and see!
picker.title: Districts
picker.intro: Each district is its own corner of town, with plots of its own.
farm.blurb.farm: Rows of wheat and carrots that grow food every hour the crews work.
farm.blurb.orchard: Fruit trees and berry bushes. They grow the most food, planted with herbs.
farm.blurb.granary: Keeps the harvest. A bigger granary stores more food.
farm.empty: An empty field, ready for planting. Choose what to grow.
farm.locked: Buy the farmland to start farming these fields.
farm.grows: Grows {food} food an hour while the crews work.
farm.growing: The crops are growing. Check back after your next log.
farm.harvested: Harvested {food} food. The stores are filling up!
farm.granaryHolds: The stores hold up to {capacity} food.
book.counts: Every building tier, district, decoration on show and festival held adds to it.
book.prosperityToGo: Prosperity {needed}: {missing} to go. Build, upgrade and decorate to get there.
book.foodToGo: {food} food in store: {missing} more to gather. Harvest your farms to fill the stores.
book.waitingOnHarvest: The town is waiting on the harvest. It keeps everything while it waits.
book.noFarmsYet: Farms come with the farmland. Food is waiting there.
book.founded: The outpost was founded. Every log since has built on it.
book.noDecorations: No decorations yet. The shop and chests bring them.
tier.gifts: Gifts for the new {tier} wait in your inbox.
